title: Marketing Email API v1 sunset (reported as 2025-11-01)
summary: HubSpot replaced the v1 Marketing Email API (/marketing-emails/v1/...) with the Marketing Email v3 API. HubSpot's own folder-ID post calls v1 "being sunset" and CData reports the endpoint as sunset; search snippets of HubSpot's (now 404) changelog post put the sunset on 2025-11-01, but that date could not be read on an open page.
migrationNote: Move email calls from /marketing-emails/v1/emails to the Marketing Email v3 API (POST /marketing/v3/emails to create, GET /marketing/v3/emails to list, GET /marketing/v3/emails/{emailId} to read one) and read folders from folderIdV2. Search snippets say other legacy email APIs, such as email analytics, were not part of this sunset.
